"""Session start cost with the installed v2 bundle on an isolated Tips copy.
cold: no .elixir_ls. seeded: .elixir_ls/build/test copied from the worktree's own _build/test. warm: existing .elixir_ls.

import json, os, queue, shutil, signal, subprocess, sys, threading, time
from pathlib import Path
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BUNDLE = Path('/private/tmp/tips-elixirls-codex-v2/agent/lsp/vendor/elixirls-neovim-v2')
ROOT = Path('/private/tmp/tips-fable-release-review-9xb93ihp/probes/mixtime/tips')
sys.path.insert(0, str(BUNDLE / 'vendor/python'))
import pynvim
out = {}
def save(k, v):
    out[k] = v; (HERE / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1) + '\n'); print(k, json.dumps(v)[:300], flush=True)
def leftovers():
    rows = subprocess.run(['ps', '-eo', 'pid,command'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
    return [r[:120] for r in rows if 'tips-fable-release-review' in r and 'startup_probe' not in r and 'ps -eo' not in r]
def session(name):
    state = HERE / f'{name}-state'
    if state.exists(): shutil.rmtree(state)
    q = queue.Queue(); t0 = time.time()
    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(BUNDLE / 'bundle.py'), 'serve', '--workspace', str(ROOT), '--state', str(state)],
        cwd=ROOT, env=os.environ | {'ERL_FLAGS': '+S 4:4'}, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=(HERE / f'{name}.stderr.log').open('w'), text=True, bufsize=1, start_new_session=True)
    def read():
        for line in proc.stdout:
            try: q.put(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError: pass
    threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True).start()
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'initialize', 'params': {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'fable-startup', 'version': '1'}}}) + '\n'); proc.stdin.flush()
    q.get(timeout=60); init = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'method': 'notifications/initialized'}) + '\n'); proc.stdin.flush()
    reg = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in (state / 'registry').glob('*.json')]
    nv = pynvim.attach('socket', path=reg[0]['socket'])
    while not nv.exec_lua("return require('neovim_sync').ready()"):
        if time.time() - t0 > 300: break
        time.sleep(0.5)
    ready = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    builds = nv.exec_lua('local n = 0; for _, e in ipairs(_G.v2_events) do if e.method == "window/logMessage" and (e.data.message or ""):find("Starting build", 1, true) then n = n + 1 end end; return n')
    took = nv.exec_lua('local r = {}; for _, e in ipairs(_G.v2_events) do if e.method == "window/logMessage" and (e.data.message or ""):find("Compile took", 1, true) then r[#r+1] = e.data.message end end; return r')
    result = nv.exec_lua("return require('neovim_sync').status()")
    nv.close()
    proc.stdin.close(); t1 = time.time()
    try: proc.wait(timeout=20)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    time.sleep(1)
    save(name, {'initialize_s': init, 'ready_s': ready, 'builds': builds, 'compile_took': took, 'status': result['status'], 'result': result.get('completed'),
                'shutdown_s': round(time.time() - t1, 2), 'leftovers': leftovers(), 'elixir_ls_size': subprocess.run(['du', '-sh', str(ROOT / '.elixir_ls')], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()[0]})
shutil.rmtree(ROOT / '.elixir_ls', ignore_errors=True)
session('cold')
session('warm')
shutil.rmtree(ROOT / '.elixir_ls', ignore_errors=True)
(ROOT / '.elixir_ls/build').mkdir(parents=True)
t = time.time(); shutil.copytree(ROOT / '_build/test', ROOT / '.elixir_ls/build/test', symlinks=True); save('seed_copy_s', round(time.time() - t, 2))
session('seeded')
session('warm_after_seed')
